youtube.baslik: Does failing auditory processing screening mean a child has the disorder? #shorts
youtube.aciklama: Screening is a brief procedure to identify children who need a detailed evaluation; not every child who fails screening has auditory processing disorder (APD), and there may be other causes, such as attention, language or hearing. Diagnosis is made with a test battery after peripheral evaluation and with a team assessment; the diagnostic test battery is usually given from about age 7.
